records.measurement: Soft enolization followed by racemic CSA protonolysis gives a 1.1:1 trans:cis ketoester mixture, slightly favouring trans.
Attempts under reversible keto–enol tautomerization conditions afforded trans material; this is an observed outcome without a directly measured equilibrium constant.
Three rounds of the CSA sequence yield 70% isolated cis material; this cumulative recycling yield is distinct from single-pass diastereoselectivity.
